description: Results classified exactly 12th are included in the filtered set, along with all later classifications.

a.request: Considering only race results whose classification order (`positionOrder`) is 12 or greater, each matched to its race, show for each race (grouped by race ID and race name) the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last.
a.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (avg_laps IS NULL) ASC, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each race (grouped by race ID and race name), using only results with `positionOrder` >= 12 (12th place and all later classifications included), joined to the races table, show the race ID, race name, and the average of `laps` ignoring nulls, ordered by that average descending with races lacking an average placed last, limited to the top 10.
d.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (avg_laps IS NULL) ASC, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For results with positionOrder of 12 or greater (inclusive of 12th place), join each result to its race and, grouped by race ID and race name, return the race ID, race name, and average laps completed (ignoring null laps values), sorted by that average in descending order with races having no average placed last, limited to the top 10 races.
b.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For results with positionOrder of 12 or greater (inclusive of 12th place), join each result to its race and, grouped by race ID and race name, return the race ID, race name, and average laps completed (ignoring null laps values), sorted by that average in descending order with races having no average placed last, limited to the top 10 races.

c.request: Looking only at back-of-the-field results, using 12 as the cutoff on classification order (`positionOrder`), and matching each result to its race: for each race (grouped by race ID and race name), show the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last. Results classified exactly 12th are included in the filtered set, along with all later classifications.
c.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN res.laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (AVG(CASE WHEN res.laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) IS NULL), avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10
